findings: The projected triangle classifier uses a dominant-normal axis and Float32-rounded coordinate equality and product comparisons; a generic double-precision orientation test is not equivalent.
The segment helper collapses squared lengths at most 9.999999974752427e-7 to the first endpoint; its returned parameter is not clamped, while the closest point is clamped and stored as Float32.
Signed triangle sampling has a strict absolute plane-distance cutoff, signed distance result, ordered nearest-edge selection and flags for all outside edges.
Float32 direction normalization rounds each square and addition, uses sqrtf, then divides using double precision and stores Float32; its length threshold is 2^-52.
Triangle-box admission uses a plane overlap test followed by edge-axis overlap tests. The full ordered admission path has not been ported.
